citations.assessment: Tanchuma son of Rabbi Abba quotes Rabbi Abba Huna the priest son of Rabbi Avin in the discussion of the Levites.
The shorter title Huna the priest son of Avin introduces Shmuel bar Nachman, who transmits the authorities in exile.
